members.label: 根轨迹与虚轴交点处的K值，即系统临界稳定时的开环增益。
The value of the nth self-loop transmittance in Mason's signal-flow gain formula.
闭环系统特征方程式的根，即闭环传递函数的极点。

A measure of the sensitivity of the system performance to specific parameter changes, given by S_K^T(s) = (∂T(s)/T(s)) / (∂K/K), where T(s) is the system transfer function and K is the parameter of interest.
The slope parameter characterizing the reaction curve, computed as R = M/τ where M is the steady-state magnitude and τ is the time constant.
A network composed of distributed R and C elements, with an attenuation slope of 10n dB/decade, where n is the order of the RC filter.
The period of the sustained oscillations, denoted by P_U, used in the closed-loop Ziegler-Nichols tuning method.
绘制根轨迹的七个步骤
A system whose transfer function has a zero in the right half-plane (RHP).
A compensation scheme used to achieve stability for systems with lightly damped flexible modes, particularly with noncollocated actuator and sensor.
齐格勒-尼科尔斯PID整定方法
A method to eliminate oscillation by lowering the loop gain at high frequency to reduce spillover into lightly damped flexible modes.
负反馈系统中根轨迹增益 K* 变化时的根轨迹称为常规根轨迹。
前向通路传递函数中时间常数形式表示的增益，记为K_G。
A variable parameter in the characteristic equation 1+KG(s)=0, where 0 ≤ K < ∞.
The percentage by which the output response exceeds the final value in response to a step input.
A method to select controller parameters by sketching the root locus as a function of a parameter and determining root values for various gains.
The finite error that remains after the output response follows a ramp input.
开环传递函数的零点，在根轨迹法中为已知量。
The measured output from an open-loop step input, assumed to have the general shape of a first-order system with a transport delay, characterized by transport delay ΔT and reaction rate R.
当闭环两个实数极点重合时，系统为临界阻尼系统，单位阶跃响应仍为非周期过程，但响应速度较快。
以非开环增益为可变参数绘制的根轨迹称为参数根轨迹，以区别于以开环增益 K 为可变参数的常规根轨迹。
The roots of b(s)=0, labeled z_i.
The condition at which the system is on the verge of instability, characterized by purely imaginary roots.
The roots of a(s)=0, labeled p_i.
反馈通路传递函数H(s)=1的反馈控制系统。
A trick used to compute angles of arrival and departure from a point of multiple roots by plotting a root locus for an initial range of K and then continuing with a new parameter.
A technique used to meet nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions standards by recirculating exhaust gas.
在复杂控制系统设计中，由于某种性能指标要求而必须包含的正反馈内回路。
The angle φ_A that the asymptote makes with respect to the real axis.
The sensitivity of the roots as a parameter changes from its normal value.
前向通路传递函数中分子多项式最高项系数归一化后的增益，记为K_G*。
A compensation scheme that approximates PD control, used to speed up response by lowering rise time and decreasing transient overshoot.
The time delay parameter characterizing the reaction curve in the open-loop Ziegler-Nichols tuning method.
The process of determining the PID controller gains by trial-and-error with minimal analytic analysis.
A point on the root locus where two or more roots come into the real axis.
A root locus plotted for negative values of the gain parameter K, also referred to as a 0° root locus.
知识命题：The locus of the roots of the characteristic equation 1+K P(s)=0 begins at the poles of P(s) and ends at the zeros of P(s) as K increases from zero to infinity.
A system possessing the reaction curve can be approximated by a first-order system with a transport delay, with transfer function G(s)=M[p/(s+p)]e^{-ΔT s}.
